name: craving of yeenoghu
mana cost: {2}{R}
types: enchantment aura
static: enchant creature you control
activated[1]: {R}: return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to target creature you control. CARDNAME perpetually gains "enchanted creature gets -1/-1." activate only as a sorcery.
static: enchanted creature gets +3/+2, has haste, and attacks each combat if able.
